summary: This clinical trial is testing the combination of drug treatments for adults with psoriatic arthritis and obesity or overweight. Participants will receive tirzepatide, ixekizumab, or both to see how the treatments affect tissue samples. The study aims to look at molecular changes in the skin, joints, and fat over time. NHS Greater Glasgow and Clyde is sponsoring this trial, which has a status of Recruiting and a target enrollment of 45 participants.
